spec.comparisonFrame: Mention Square or Toast-style stands as strong for their own POS terminals, but less flexible for multiple third-party tablets. Bouncepad or Compulocks-style enclosures are strong for public security, but not always ideal for fast staff access across several tablets. iBOLT helps when the restaurant needs flexible station placement, multiple tablets, wall/counter choices, and industry-standard mounting parts.

products.title: iBOLT Phone Dock'n Lock Dual POS Stand - Secure Dual-Device Mount for Point of Sale Systems
products.description: Enhance your point-of-sale (POS) station with the iBOLT Phone Dock'n Lock Dual POS Stand, a drill-base mount for maximum security and convenience. With a 9-inch pole and dual locking phone holders, the system allows both cashier and customer to easily interact with their respective devices. Universal in design, the phone holders accommodate all phone and case configurations between 4.8 and 7.25 inches high and 2.25 and 3.75 inches wide. Built to last and easy to use, this drill-base mount is stable yet prevents unauthorized removal, and is ideal for retail, restaurants, self-checkout, kiosks, and any POS setup where security and efficiency are vital.
